sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Internet Retailing of Outdoor Sports and Camping Gear

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (unitary national jurisdiction; International Companies regime administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law and French Civil Law foundation, with customary law recognized under the Constitution of Vanuatu 1980)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) - regional trade and development agreement in force for Vanuatu since 2020
WTO Membership (accession 24 August 2012) - most-favoured-nation and trade facilitation framework
Melanesian Spearhead Group (MSG) Trade Agreement - regional preferential market access arrangement

No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty (BIT) or double taxation agreement (DTAA) is currently in force for standard Vanuatu International Companies; Vanuatu exempts International Companies from income tax, and tax transparency is coordinated through APG/FATF and international information-exchange arrangements

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Act No. 32 of 1992, as amended) administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Act No. 17 of 2020 (as amended, in force from 1 April 2021); VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook (2021 edition, as supplemented); Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit directives; FATF Recommendations as implemented through the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) membership obligations, enforceable through VFSC licensing and enforcement powers and through the International Companies Act registered-agent and record-keeping requirements.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the bio-data page of the passport of each proposed director, secretary, shareholder, and 25%+ ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or competent passport-issuing authority in the country of origin (certification countersigned per local notarial practice)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization only - Republic of Vanuatu is not a Party to the Hague Apostille Convention (1961); chain: Notary Public to Ministry of Foreign Affairs or other designated authority of the issuing country, then to the competent Vanuatu consular or diplomatic mission; where no Vanuatu mission exists, the issuing state's authentication plus certified English/French translation is accepted in prevailing practice

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or certified proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement issued within 90 days) for each director and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank or public utility provider in the country of residence; the copy is notarized by a Notary Public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization chain as described above; acceptable alternative: original bank-stamped letter on bank letterhead together with notarized signature verification where no Vanuatu consular post has jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference letter confirming bona fides and professional acquaintance (minimum two years) from a licensed lawyer, certified public accountant, or licensed securities or brokerage professional
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Qualified legal or accounting professional subject to a recognized AML/CFT regime
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization chain as described above, or notarized copy accompanied by the professional's AML/CFT registration credential

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or certificate of incorporation (or equivalent registry extract) for each corporate shareholder or corporate ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or corporate registrar of the corporate shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization chain as described above - a Hague Apostille from an Apostille-party origin country is NOT recognized by Vanuatu and must be replaced by the consular legalization chain unless a bilateral legalization convention applies

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney and incorporation engagement letter authorizing the VFSC-licensed Vanuatu registered agent to file the International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Instructing client (individual or authorized officer of a corporate shareholder) and Notary Public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization chain as described above; where the client is outside Vanuatu and no consular post is reasonably available, the registered agent may accept a scanned notarized original followed by courier of the wet-ink original within 30 days

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 [Cap 222] (Republic of Vanuatu), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2014; applicable sections include s. 10 (manner of incorporation), s. 12 (certificate of incorporation), s. 14 (registered office and registered agent), s. 34 (one or more directors) and the statutory tax-exemption provisions exempting International Companies from Vanuatu income tax, capital gains tax and withholding tax.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Registry Division, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 - Application for Registration of an International Company, submitted with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association and the registered agent's consent; the final instrument issued is the Certificate of Incorporation under s. 12 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital and no escrow rule; an International Company may issue no-par-value shares and defer payment of consideration; the VFSC registration fee is approx. USD 300 plus a Commission-set annual renewal fee.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscription for, and allotment of, one ordinary share of no par value to the founding subscriber be ratified and entered in the share register. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office maintained by the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu be adopted as the Company's statutory registered office, and the agent be authorised to file all statutory records. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the director named in the minutes be appointed as first director, with authority to execute banking instructions, appoint a secretary, and undertake all acts necessary to open payment-processing accounts. FURTHER RESOLVED, that these resolutions be certified by the chair and take effect immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Names Unit, Port Vila; filing is normally effected through a VFSC-licensed registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the prescribed name-reservation application with two or three proposed names, each ending in Limited, Corporation, Incorporated or Pty Ltd, and pay the name-search fee; the VFSC checks the names registry and issues a written name approval valid for ninety days.
required_dossiers: Prescribed application for name reservation
Two to three proposed company names
Identity document of the applicant or licensed agent's covering letter
Proof of payment of the name-search fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is rejected as undesirable, prohibited or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity, file substitute names under the same application or submit a new request; the applicant may contest the refusal in writing to the VFSC under its internal review procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of the Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent (attestation), prior to filing with the VFSC Companies Registry.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English to conform with the International Companies Act and VFSC precedent; the sole subscriber executes the documents before a witness; beneficial-owner identification documents are collected and verified; the agent certifies the documents as proper for filing.
required_dossiers: Drafted Memorandum and Articles of Association
Subscriber's certified passport copy and proof of residential address
Curriculum vitae or background statement of the subscriber
Bank or professional reference letter
Beneficial ownership identification form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC informal pre-review queries the objects or capital wording, the agent amends the text and re-executes the documents; any notarisation defect is cured by a fresh attestation before a Vanuatu notary or a foreign notary recognised by the VFSC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the Registration Application with the VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry, Port Vila (statutory filing window).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form 1 together with the executed constitutive documents, the name-approval slip and the registered agent's consent, and pay the official registration fee of approximately USD 300 (VT 35,000) plus the agent's professional fee; the VFSC verifies statutory compliance and enters the company on the International Companies Register.
required_dossiers: Form 1 - Application for Registration of an International Company
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Name approval slip
Consent of the licensed registered agent to act
Certified identification documents of directors, shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners
Proof of payment of the registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The VFSC issues a query letter for any defect; the applicant must respond in writing within fourteen days, curing the stated defect by re-execution, re-notarisation or fee top-up; failure to respond leads to withdrawal of the application without prejudice to a fresh filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation dated as of the day of registration; the agent prepares the corporate kit, including the common seal, blank share certificates, register of members, register of directors and register of charges, and distributes the originals to the client.
required_dossiers: Approved Form 1 and registered constitutive documents
Receipt of official filing fees
Registered agent's post-registration compliance intake
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate carries typographical or legal errors, submit a written rectification request with the certificate and supporting documents to the Registrar; corrections are made administratively without a new incorporation application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance, Bank Account and Payment-Rails Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of directors acting with the licensed registered agent; Vanuatu licensed commercial banks and global payment processors (Stripe and PayPal).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The first board adopts the registered office, records the share allotment and appoints officers; a corporate bank account is opened at a Vanuatu licensed bank or an approved regional bank; the Stripe and PayPal applications are submitted with the corporate due-diligence pack; if target markets require seller registrations, the company completes those through a virtual-office service provider.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and corporate kit
Certified first board resolutions
Certified director and ultimate beneficial owner identification
Bank reference and proof of address
Incumbency certificate issued by the registered agent
Payment processor onboarding questionnaires (Stripe and PayPal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank or payment processor requires enhanced due diligence, supply the registered agent's certificate of good standing and a corporate-ownership chart demonstrating low-risk outdoor-gear e-commerce; if the processor's supported-country list excludes Vanuatu, establish a marketplace seller profile or a lightweight foreign merchant registration in a supported jurisdiction.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry (Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce) - licensing jurisdiction arises only for physical manufacturing, warehousing or shopfront operation; not engaged for pure online retail.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required - no industrial, wholesale or physical retail permit applies; the International Company is prohibited by statute from carrying on local business in Vanuatu and conducts all sales through third-party online marketplaces and overseas fulfilment, which falls outside the Vanuatu business-licensing regime.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation, Ministry of Climate Change and Natural-Disaster Management.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Exempt from EIA registration and report; no land disturbance, construction or manufacturing is undertaken in Vanuatu; the activity is limited to offshore internet retailing of camping equipment with no in-country environmental footprint.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable - zero point-source discharge, wastewater, volatile organic compound emissions or hazardous-waste generation attributable to the Vanuatu entity; if a warehouse or fulfilment centre is later opened in Vanuatu, the Waste Management Act, the Water Resources Management Act and DEPC discharge permitting would apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable - no employees, office, warehouse or shopfront in Vanuatu, so no fire-safety certification, structural-load inspection or workplace registration is triggered; if the company later establishes a physical administrative office, a Port Vila Municipality trade licence, fire service clearance and occupancy inspection would become mandatory.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Department (VRCD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; official customs and revenue portal: https://www.customs.gov.vu; foreign investment licensing portal: https://www.vipa.gov.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: No TIN or VAT ID exists for Vanuatu International Companies (ICs). An IC incorporated under the International Companies Act Cap. 222 is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes and is not registered with VRCD for income tax. The sole administrative ancillary registration is the annual Vanuatu Business Licence (VBL) under the Business Licence Act Cap. 250, applicable only if the IC establishes a physical presence or trades domestically in Vanuatu; a pure offshore e-commerce retailer using Stripe/PayPal with no local establishment requires no tax registration and no taxpayer identification number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None available. Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, no VAT/GST, no capital gains tax, and no withholding tax; consequently no check-the-box, hybrid mismatch, or fiscal-transparency elections exist in Vanuatu law. The IC may voluntarily elect in its constitutional documents to confine its activities to offshore trading, or by special resolution convert to a domestic company under the Companies Act Cap. 191, which would trigger only the nominal annual business licence fee and no tax liability.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT, GST, or sales and use tax is in force in Vanuatu. Indirect levies are limited to customs import duties (Customs Act Cap. 251), excise duties on alcohol, tobacco and hydrocarbon fuels, and the 15% tourism levy (12.5% tourism levy plus 2.5% eco-tourism levy) which applies solely to accommodation and designated tourism services and does not extend to internet retailing of goods.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - Vanuatu has no VAT/GST regime, therefore no economic turnover threshold triggers indirect tax registration. The only monetary threshold in force is the annual VBL fee band, which is activity-based and generally ranges between VUV 1,000 and VUV 50,000 for retail-type businesses with a physical Vanuatu presence.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Vanuatu operates no real-time fiscal clearance, no continuous transaction controls (CTC), no e-invoicing API mandate, and no digital stamping requirement. Ordinary commercial invoices are accepted; for physical cross-border cargo conveyance only, the ASYCUDA World customs declaration platform is employed.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable in the absence of any VAT/GST system. Exported goods and offshore e-commerce sales of outdoor camping equipment fall wholly outside the scope of Vanuatu taxation; no zero-rating claim, input tax credit, or export refund mechanism exists. Outward-bound cargo is automatically free of export duty, and digital sales by the IC to non-resident consumers via Stripe/PayPal incur zero Vanuatu tax liability.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: None required for purely digital/offshore sales without physical movement of goods through Vanuatu territory
If goods are physically exported via Vanuatu ports: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World), Commercial Invoice, Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback exposure exists because no VAT system is in force. Adjacent statutory penalties: false customs declarations under the Customs Act Cap. 251 attract fines and/or imprisonment as prescribed by that Act; an IC engaging in prohibited domestic trading without a business licence may be subject to penalty and forfeiture of profits under the International Companies Act Cap. 222. Offshore export earnings of the IC are exempt from all Vanuatu taxation with no retrospective clawback risk.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Central Bank Act [Cap. 125], which also prudentially supervises licensed commercial banks and financial dealers under the Banking Act [Cap. 63]. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) regulates International Companies under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], but holds no FX control mandate.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu has no exchange control legislation and imposes no restrictions on current-account or capital-account transactions. The Vatu (VUV) is fully convertible; the IC may hold, convert, and remit USD, AUD, EUR, NZD, and other freely usable currencies without RBV prior approval. Capital injections, dividend distributions, profit repatriation, and cross-border trade settlements are unrestricted. The VUV operates on a managed float against a basket of currencies with no dual-rate mechanism and no resident/non-resident market segmentation. Profit remittance hurdles are nil, provided the entity holds a valid VFSC Certificate of Good Standing and the bank has current beneficial-ownership documentation. No exchange-control approval is required for the target payment rails (Stripe and PayPal settlement in USD).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion rules exist in Vanuatu. An exporting International Company may retain 100% of export receipts in VUV or in a foreign-currency account (FCA) at a licensed bank; there is no time limit for repatriation and no conversion ratio. The only obligations are statistical: the bank must report balance-of-payments (ITRS) data to the RBV, and the entity must provide trade-in-services data to the Vanuatu National Statistics Office when required. This accommodates an e-commerce retail model where USD proceeds from Stripe/PayPal are settled as FX to VUV or USD trade accounts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Low-to-Medium. Vanuatu has no domestic EMI licensing regime, and major offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Mercury, Revolut Business, Currenxie) generally decline Vanuatu-domiciled International Companies due to jurisdiction risk and the absence of a local SWIFT BIC relationship. A viable modality is to use Payoneer or Airwallex as payment aggregators for Shopify/Amazon settlements, then sweep balances via SWIFT to the Tier-1 Vanuatu bank account. A separately established US LLC may hold the Stripe merchant account, but this does not constitute EMI banking for the VU-IC. Legal constraint: the EMI route cannot replace the statutory requirement to maintain a licensed registered agent and registered office in Vanuatu under the IC Act.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory mandate requires directors to appear physically in Vanuatu. Under the Financial Institutions (AML/CFT) Act 2016, banks may rely on a licensed introducer (the registered agent) plus a live video interview with a relationship manager and certified true copies of passports and proof of address. In practice, ANZ and BSP accept remote video onboarding for non-resident directors; BRED generally requires a video call plus notarised corporate resolutions; NBV typically requires physical presence or a notarised power of attorney executed at a Vanuatu diplomatic mission.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore-IC shell classification: correspondent banks perceive VFSC-registered International Companies as lacking economic substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Substance pack: (1) registered agent's Certificate of Incumbency; (2) registered-office lease in Port Vila; (3) board minutes evidencing treasury and trading decisions; (4) executed e-commerce supply contracts with third-party warehouses and logistics carriers; (5) 12-month business plan for ISIC 4791; (6) payments for cloud services, gateway fees, and supplier invoices demonstrating active trade.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial ownership chain: nominee shareholders or multi-tier offshore ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transparency pack: (1) VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and current Register of Members; (2) natural-person UBO declaration with passport and residential address; (3) declaration of trust covering any nominee arrangement; (4) confirmation that bearer shares are prohibited; (5) sanctions and PEP screening results for all UBOs; (6) CRS self-certification and tax-residence evidence from the UBO home jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdiction-risk de-risking: FATF increased-monitoring history (2021-2023) and Vanuatu citizenship-by-investment (CBI) passport concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Compliance pack: (1) FATF October 2023 statement confirming removal from the grey list; (2) written legal opinion of a Vanuatu-licensed counsel confirming the IC is not a CBI vehicle and that all UBOs are long-term tax residents of their home states; (3) evidence that passport holders are not recent investors; (4) AML/CFT training certificates for directors and signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PSP flow-through risk: irregular Stripe/PayPal settlement volumes and marketplace chargeback patterns may trigger suspicious-transaction reports.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: E-commerce evidence packet: (1) real-time gateway settlement statements mapping gross sales, refunds, and chargebacks; (2) customer invoices with carrier proof (UPS, DHL, local postal records) for camping gear deliveries; (3) reconciliation of Shopify/Amazon payouts to bank credits; (4) chargeback ratio below 1%; (5) documented split-transfer structure (US LLC/PayPal to VU-IC treasury account) pre-approved by the bank's compliance officer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing uses SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's bank with purpose code 'Equity capital - contribution to foreign incorporated enterprise' (IMF BPM6/ITRS category) and remittance reference 'VU-IC share capital injection'. Beneficiary name must exactly match the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation; the registered agent's Port Vila address and the IC registration number must appear in the beneficiary field. Bank-side verification comprises: (1) matching remitter to Certificate of Incumbency, (2) source-of-wealth forms for transfers above VUV 1 million (approx. USD 8,500), (3) CRS self-certification, and (4) RBV BOP reporting by the bank. No RBV approval, no excise, stamp duty, or capital duty is levied. For USD amounts above USD 100,000, pre-notification to the bank's ODD unit is advisable to avoid OFAC false positives on the correspondent chain (ANZ Australia / Westpac New Zealand / BSP PNG).
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For trade settlements (inventory purchases of outdoor camping equipment from Asian suppliers), preferred rails are: (1) SWIFT MT103 for purchase-order payments with purpose code 'Import of goods for resale' and the supplier invoice number; (2) commercial letters of credit issued by the Vanuatu bank via MT700 for bulk orders above USD 200,000, confirmed by the supplier's Chinese or Vietnamese bank; (3) MT202 COV for correspondent-bank cover when executing same-day USD clearing; (4) domestic beneficiary payments settled via the Vanuatu Interbank Payment System (VIPS) where local vendors are used; and (5) SWIFT GPI enabled on all outbound wires for end-to-end tracking. Open-account terms should be matched to the IC's FCA balance to avoid overdraft triggers; supplier payments in USD, AUD, or EUR eliminate unnecessary VUV conversion friction.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable forwards in VUV/USD, VUV/AUD, and VUV/EUR offered onshore by ANZ, BSP, and BRED on a back-to-back trade-contract basis
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for VUV against USD executed through offshore dealers in Singapore or Hong Kong, permissible because Vanuatu does not restrict offshore hedging
Cross-currency swaps (VUV/USD, VUV/AUD) for long-term matching of foreign-currency supplier commitments
Plain-vanilla FX options (VUV call / USD put and VUV put / USD call) available through licensed onshore banks
Natural hedging by denominating procurement and revenue in USD while maintaining only operational float in VUV

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and payment of Annual Government Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), filed through the licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty equal to 25% of the unpaid annual fee after the 30-day grace period; administrative strike-off and dissolution possible after three months of continued non-payment and after 30 days' notice to the Company and its registered agent.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for International Companies (ICs) not engaged in a licensed activity; VFSC may, in its discretion, order an audit where the IC has more than 30 shareholders, has issued securities to the public, or where the public interest so requires. No automatic statutory audit applies to ISIC 4791 internet retailing of outdoor camping equipment.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory financial statements are required for ICs; if prepared voluntarily, IFRS or another internationally accepted general accounting framework is used.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must maintain an internal beneficial-ownership register and must collect a formal annual UBO confirmation for each member as part of the annual return cycle. Every share transfer must be effected by a written instrument, approved by directors' resolution, recorded in the Register of Members, and notified to the registered agent for updating the beneficial-ownership record. Failure to notify transfers within 30 days may constitute an offence under the International Companies Act.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 - USD 800 per annum (typical licensed registered agent fee inclusive of registered office and registered agent services)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 for statutory audit (none required); voluntary audit USD 2,500 - USD 5,000 if commissioned by management, shareholders, or a third-party lender

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0%. Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax, and no estate or inheritance tax. An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] is wholly outside the Vanuatu income tax net.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective tax burden is permanently zero for a compliant IC. The International Companies Act confers a statutory exemption from all Vanuatu taxes on the company's worldwide income. No additional tax holiday or preferential deduction is available because the base rate is already nil. The 12.5% Value Added Tax (VAT) applies only to taxable supplies made in Vanuatu; it is not triggered by an IC conducting genuinely offshore internet retailing of outdoor camping equipment because the IC is statutorily prohibited from carrying on business within Vanuatu, and exported goods are zero-rated. There is no loss relief regime because no income tax exists.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. The only annual statutory filing is the International Company Annual Return together with the government licence renewal fee remittance, submitted through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-services portal, in practice by the licensed registered agent on behalf of the IC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Return and the prescribed renewal licence fee must be lodged on or before the anniversary date of incorporation in each calendar year. No statutory extension exists; the VFSC portal generates a renewal reminder approximately 30 days before the anniversary.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Registered Name of International Company
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name of the IC as recorded in the International Companies Register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners must use the exact registered English name; no trading alias, e-commerce store name or DBA is accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique registration number assigned by the Registrar of International Companies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Quote the number prefixed 'IC-' exactly as shown in the certificate of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - Registered Office Address in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Street address of the registered office, which must be physically located in Vanuatu and must be the office of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign or virtual address is not permissible; the Port Vila office address of the registered agent must be stated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and VFSC licence number of the appointed registered agent resident in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the agent's licence status; any change of agent must be effected and gazetted before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal names, nationalities, residential addresses and dates of birth for all directors, plus any company secretary or officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be non-resident; passport copies and a valid address for service of process must be lodged with the agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names of all shareholders, classes of shares, and percentage ownership.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bearer shares are prohibited; every ultimate beneficial owner must be identified and supported by KYC evidence held by the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory declaration that the IC has not carried on business in Vanuatu, has not derived income from Vanuatu sources, and does not own or hold any interest in land in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For online camping-equipment retailing, declare that no goods are sold to Vanuatu residents and that no warehouse, business premises, or local employees exist in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 - Beneficial Ownership and AML Record Confirmation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation by the registered agent that the beneficial ownership register has been maintained and that KYC documentation is held on file under Vanuatu AML/CFT obligations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The ultimate beneficial owner must supply passport, proof of residential address, and a source-of-funds declaration covering Stripe and PayPal settlement flows.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Remittance of the renewal fee in accordance with the gazetted VFSC fee schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The fee is payable in US dollars to the VFSC account; third-party or cash payments are not accepted.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late lodgement attracts cumulative late fees under the prescribed International Companies Act fee regulations, assessed monthly with each month of default. Continued default enables the Registrar to strike the IC off the international register; dissolution extinguishes separate legal personality and the tax-exempt status, and outstanding liabilities may fall upon the assets and directors personally.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%. Vanuatu has no withholding tax legislation. Dividends distributed by an International Company to non-resident shareholders are entirely outside the Vanuatu tax net; no dividend tax, distribution tax, or dividend withholding tax is chargeable.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network in force and maintains no administrative procedure for issuing a tax residency certificate or TRC, because Vanuatu does not impose income tax and does not recognise corporate tax residence. Foreign shareholders seeking treaty benefits must rely solely on their home-jurisdiction rules; the Vanuatu registered agent may issue only a certified statement of incorporation and statutory exemption, which does not constitute a TRC and must not be represented as such.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 0% on outbound royalty payments and 0% on outbound interest payments. Treaty-reduced rates: none applicable because no DTA network exists. Intra-group licence fees for the online retail brand or IP and interest on shareholder loans may therefore be remitted free of any Vanuatu withholding tax.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None. Vanuatu has not enacted transfer-pricing, Master File, Local File, or Country-by-Country reporting legislation. No VUV threshold triggers a mandatory Local File or Master File, and no advance pricing agreement mechanism exists for an IC. If the IC belongs to a multinational group exceeding EUR 750 million consolidated revenue, any CbCR and transfer-pricing documentation obligation is discharged by the foreign ultimate parent under its own jurisdiction's rules; no Vanuatu filing is thereby generated.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted explicit Economic Substance Regulations comparable to the EU or UK ESR codes. Instead, the International Companies Act imposes a statutory offshore-substance boundary: an IC may not carry on business in Vanuatu, may not derive income from Vanuatu sources, and may not hold Vanuatu land. The registered office, licensed registered agent, and corporate records maintained in Port Vila constitute the only substance required by domestic law. However, under Vanuatu's participation in the OECD Inclusive Framework on BEPS, CRS/FATCA, and the domestic AML/CFT regime, a genuine online retailing business must exhibit substantive commercial activity in its target end-markets, including fulfilment contracts, payment-processing agreements, customer records, and invoicing history. A corporate envelope with no activity beyond nominee registration is a recognised shell indicator for FATF, EU listing, and correspondent-bank due diligence irrespective of Vanuatu domestic law.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Unlawful Local Business Activity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling outdoor camping equipment to customers within Vanuatu, operating local warehouse or office premises in Port Vila, hiring Vanuatu-resident staff, or deriving any Vanuatu-source income while continuing to claim the IC statutory tax exemption; equivalently, carrying on a taxable local supply activity without VAT registration and invoicing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic loss of the IC exemption; the entity becomes assessable to 12.5% VAT on Vanuatu supplies and may be exposed under any future corporate income tax legislation; VFSC fines under the International Companies Act and revocation of the IC certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced; directors and ultimate beneficial owners are jointly and severally liable for unpaid VAT, penalties and costs. Criminal prosecution under the Penal Code [Cap. 17] for tax fraud may result in imprisonment, court-ordered restitution, and disqualification from acting as company officers.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Artificial Shell Arrangement and Misuse of Corporate Form
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC purely as a pass-through shell for Stripe and PayPal receivables with no board activity, no books or records maintained at the registered office, and nominee-only concealment of the ultimate beneficial owner; or representing the IC as a 'Vanuatu tax-resident' trading company to foreign suppliers, payment processors, or tax authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off by the Registrar of International Companies; forfeiture of limited liability protection; withdrawal of the statutory tax exemption; classification as a shell or passive vehicle in FATF/OECD/EU assessments; and termination of correspondent banking relationships.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may lift the corporate veil and hold directors personally liable for creditor losses; the Vanuatu Supreme Court may impose travel bans and asset freezes; directors convicted of fraudulent trading face imprisonment, disqualification, and personal civil restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering and Financial Sanctions Violation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Moving retail settlement funds through the IC without adequate source-of-funds and beneficial-ownership KYC documentation, accepting payments from customers subject to international financial sanctions, or using the IC to launder proceeds of fraud, chargeback abuse, or payment-card theft.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Enforcement under the Vanuatu AML/CFT legal framework, including the AML/CFT Act 2021 and Financial Intelligence Unit powers: monetary fines, freezing of bank and payment accounts, forfeiture of funds, and termination of the registered-agent relationship.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the ultimate beneficial owner face criminal money-laundering charges punishable by imprisonment, confiscation of property, loss of travel documents, and re-entry bans into Vanuatu; extraterritorial sanctions liability may also arise from the payment processors' own compliance obligations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing a self-drafted 'Vanuatu tax residence certificate', claiming eligibility for double-tax-treaty benefits in the United States, EU, or Asia-Pacific markets, or submitting such false statements to banks, tax authorities, or e-commerce platforms to reduce foreign withholding on remittances.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Prosecution for fraud under the Penal Code [Cap. 17]; circulation of false official-looking certificates is a criminal offence; VFSC cancellation of the IC registration; rejection of the claim by the foreign tax authority with interest and penalties imposed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability with imprisonment; extradition exposure under Vanuatu's Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters framework; permanent travel bans and disqualification orders; civil fraud claims by shareholders and counterparties.
